scope: Observed-response sampling, source-held Train screening, new-response sequential Train validation and fixed full-Train refits on original Dev. Controlled documents and responses, not organizational effectiveness.

screen.scope: Observed-only balanced sampling on cached own-state Train returns; frozen parent continuations, not full candidate-policy outcomes.

plan.scope: Same 1204 cached observed Train states, 11044 sampled parent-continuation rollouts, 928 fit / 276 held states, frozen encoder and 350->128->2 numeric head. Reuse completed uniform-control runs whose exact inputs, initial weights and update budgets are pinned; do not retrain identical controls.
plan.sampling: Half uniform across fitting states; half uniform across benchmark, observed response category, source family, and state. Categories are initial/answered/partial/unanswered from past request answers only, excluding retrieval. No losses, correctness, state labels, hidden environment or held-source data in probabilities.
plan.hypothesis: Four retail fitting states have a failed mandatory response and a remaining query (0.431% of uniform samples). Their initial mean gradient opposes the global mean (cosine -0.794), while inherited Tanh activations frequently saturate. Change sampling alone; this experiment does not isolate or claim to fix saturation.
plan.gates: All three seeds must improve chosen-action held-Train target loss over their numeric uniform control, worsen neither benchmark and add no expected false handoffs. Keep the identical equal-family/equal-benchmark criterion, with the initial head eligible and earliest strict improvement selected. Only then compare actual sequential Train outcomes with independently sampled responses before any full refit/Dev validation.

sequentialTrainCheck.requirement: Compare each inner selected candidate and its corresponding uniform head on the same original Train episodes and common response draws. Require lower equal-benchmark normalized mean loss across all three seeds, neither benchmark worse, and no more false handoffs. Finite controlled Train check, not independent effectiveness.

sequential.scope: Actual sequential Train policies with new common channel-wise response draws; controlled documents and responses, not independent effectiveness.

registration.scope: Execute the exact sequential Train gate already specified before balanced-head training. The response environment uses the same field-specific random draw across policies, independent of request order. Reuse deterministic constructor/encoder outputs by complete observed view; recompute each new head and verify direct forward parity. No training and no Dev/Test.

runtimeCorrection.reason: First-view cache serialization needed tensor values and tuple dictionary keys. Both failed before any completed rollout. Typed recursive canonical form passes 12 actual Train views, reordered dictionaries, changed tensor types/shapes/values and tuple-key checks. No weight, case, seed or criterion change.

responsePlan.requirement: Compare each inner selected candidate and its corresponding uniform head on the same original Train episodes and common response draws. Require lower equal-benchmark normalized mean loss across all three seeds, neither benchmark worse, and no more false handoffs. Finite controlled Train check, not independent effectiveness.

refit.scope: Full Train refit at epochs fixed by the prior source-held screen; no epoch selection or evaluation on Dev/Test.

plan.scope: Both conditions refit all 1204 Train states / 85 source families. Same initial weights and 40 epochs x 19 updates x 64 draws, same actual targets and optimizer. Capture fixed epochs from the completed source-held screen; do not reselect from full-Train or Dev scores. Preserve final heads, fixed selected heads, both optimizer states, every batch and epoch loss.

devPlan.scope: Frozen full-refit heads, all three seeds. Same original 60 generated Dev cases and 336 retail Dev conditions; evaluate all 16 channel-availability patterns and weight at 0, 0.1 and 0.2. No Test or frozen 27-source use.
devPlan.gates: Every balanced seed must worsen neither benchmark relative to its uniform refit and the retained parent: generated mean total and retail mean total on complete periods at all three response rates. No more false handoffs or requests for already resolved fields; no lower final parameter/state/evidence accuracy. Under retail no-dropout, retain all required requests, recoveries and handoffs. Public document metrics must not decrease. At least one actual mean total must strictly improve over the retained parent across all seeds; candidate remains fixed seed 42, not a post-hoc best seed.
devPlan.interpretation: Report terminal loss and request costs separately; controlled documents and responses do not establish organizational effectiveness. Retain unchanged model if any required gate fails.

dev.scope: Frozen full-Train refits on the original controlled Dev; no Test or new-source holdout.

scope.scope: Frozen full-refit heads, all three seeds. Same original 60 generated Dev cases and 336 retail Dev conditions; evaluate all 16 channel-availability patterns and weight at 0, 0.1 and 0.2. No Test or frozen 27-source use.
scope.gates: Every balanced seed must worsen neither benchmark relative to its uniform refit and the retained parent: generated mean total and retail mean total on complete periods at all three response rates. Public document metrics must not decrease. At least one actual mean total must strictly improve over the retained parent across all seeds; candidate remains fixed seed 42, not a post-hoc best seed.

rawFormat: The archive contains decompressed .jsonl records, byte-for-byte identical to the measured gzip contents. raw-format.json preserves original gzip hashes and exact raw-byte hashes. This avoids recompressing already compressed streams; no measurements or their order were changed.

outcomeAudit.scope: Raw saved trajectories and measurements only; no new inference or selection.

refitDiagnostic.scope: L40S diagnosis on the same cached Train states; not a new sequential evaluation or selection. No changes to registered selected epochs.

publishedReproduction.scope: Reproduce fixed Dev examples from the released base bundle and public head records.
publishedReproduction.selection: Fixed stride of each original Dev cohort; no outcome selection.
publishedReproduction.scopeNote: Actual model inference and sequential rollouts from public bundle/head/input assets on a fixed-stride Dev subset; reproduction only, no new selection or effectiveness evaluation.
